name: Zephic Jossax
keeps: the weights, and the habit of checking them
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: The word alchemy carries an Arabic article on the front of it because of this tradition.
text: Zephic jossax of the borrowed hour, keeps a door for the 17th tranche, doors 153 to 161. Keeps the weights, and the habit of checking them. Reads Jabir ibn Hayyan (Geber).
